recipes.name: Chocolate Rice Pudding
recipes.description: A creamy cocoa rice pudding served warm or chilled.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Rinse the rice and place it in a saucepan with the whole milk.
Cook over low heat, stirring often, until the rice becomes tender.
Stir in the sugar, cocoa powder, salt, and vanilla, mixing until the flavorings are evenly incorporated.
Keep cooking gently until the pudding becomes thick and creamy, stirring often so the bottom does not catch.
Serve warm, or chill it first if you want a colder dessert.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.

recipes.name: Vanilla Custard Cups
recipes.description: Simple baked vanilla custard with a smooth and gentle texture.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Heat the oven first so it is ready when the dish is assembled, then prepare the baking dish or pan mentioned for the recipe.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, vanilla, and salt in a bowl steadily until the mixture looks smooth and evenly blended.
Warm the whole milk gently, then slowly whisk it into the egg mixture so the custard stays smooth.
Pour the custard into the cups, then add hot water to the baking dish so the custards bake gently.
Bake until the custard is set, checking near the end so it does not overcook.
Cool before serving.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.

recipes.name: Lemon Posset
recipes.description: A bright chilled cream dessert with a smooth lemon flavor.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Pour the table cream and sugar into a saucepan and stir them together before turning on the heat.
Heat gently and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Simmer gently briefly, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Remove from heat.
Stir in the lemon juice and lemon zest, mixing until the flavorings are evenly incorporated.
Pour the mixture into cups, smooth the tops if needed, and chill until firm before serving.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Baked Apples
recipes.description: Warm apples baked with cinnamon and a light syrup.
instructions: Preheat the oven before assembling the recipe so it is ready when the dish needs to bake.
Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Peel the apples if desired and remove the cores.
Place the apples in a baking dish carefully, spreading everything into an even layer.
Mix the sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice, and water thoroughly, stopping when the mixture looks evenly combined.
Pour the syrup over the apples, making sure it reaches the bottom of the dish as well as the tops.
Bake until the apples are tender and glossy, checking near the end so it does not overcook.
Let the dessert cool, set, or rest as needed before serving so the final texture holds properly.

recipes.name: Strawberry Milk Pudding
recipes.description: A chilled pudding with strawberries and a soft milk base.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Slice the strawberries and reserve a few attractive pieces for serving.
Whisk the whole milk, sugar, cornstarch, and vanilla in a saucepan steadily until the mixture looks smooth and evenly blended.
Cook over medium heat while stirring until thick.
Fold in the strawberries gently so the mixture stays light and evenly combined.
Pour the mixture into cups, smooth the tops if needed, and chill until firm before serving.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.

recipes.name: Coconut Tapioca Cream
recipes.description: A soft tapioca dessert made with coconut milk and sugar.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Soak the tapioca pearls in water until they begin to soften, then drain them before cooking so the texture stays even.
Simmer gently the tapioca with water until translucent, stirring occasionally and watching for the texture described.
Add the coconut milk, sugar, and salt, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Cook gently until the cream thickens.
Serve warm or chilled, depending on the texture you prefer.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.

recipes.name: Orange Semolina Cake
recipes.description: A moist citrus cake with a soft crumb and orange syrup.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Heat the oven first so it is ready when the dish is assembled, then prepare the baking dish or pan mentioned for the recipe.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, orange juice, and vegetable oil steadily until the mixture looks smooth and evenly blended.
Fold in the semolina, plain flour, and baking powder gently so the mixture stays light and evenly combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and level the top so it bakes evenly.
Bake until golden and let it cool before serving, checking near the end so it does not overcook.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.

recipes.name: Caramel Banana Skillet
recipes.description: Bananas cooked in a quick caramel sauce for a simple dessert.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Slice the bananas lengthwise into even pieces so they warm through without breaking apart.
Melt gently the sugar with water in a skillet until it turns golden, stirring until smooth and taking care not to scorch it.
Add the butter and stir until smooth, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Place the bananas in the caramel and cook briefly on each side carefully, spreading everything into an even layer.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve warm.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.

recipes.name: Mango Lime Sorbet
recipes.description: A refreshing fruit sorbet with mango and lime.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Peel the mango, remove the flesh from the pit, and cut it into pieces small enough to blend smoothly.
Blend the mango with sugar, lime juice, and water until completely smooth.
Pour the mixture into a shallow container so it freezes evenly.
Freeze until firm, stirring once during freezing.
Scoop and serve cold, letting the sorbet soften for a minute if it is too firm.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.

recipes.name: Chocolate Mug Cake
recipes.description: A fast individual chocolate cake cooked without an oven.
instructions: Read through the full recipe and prepare the work area so each ingredient can be added at the right moment.
Mix the plain flour, cocoa powder, sugar, and baking powder in a mug thoroughly, stopping when the mixture looks evenly combined.
Add the whole milk and vegetable oil, stirring well so everything is evenly distributed.
Stir until the batter is smooth.
Cook until the cake rises and becomes firm.
Let it cool briefly before eating so the texture settles before serving.
Check the final texture before serving so the dessert is set, smooth, or warm as intended.
